title_en: Opinion of the Supreme People's Court on Thoroughly Studying and Implementing Xi Jinping's Thought on Ecological Civilization to Provide Judicial Services and Guarantees for Ecological Environmental Protection in the New Era
full_text_en:
Supreme People's Court

Opinions on Deeply Studying and Implementing Xi Jinping's Thought on Ecological Civilization to Provide Judicial Services and Safeguards for Ecological Environmental Protection in the New Era

Fa Fa [2018] No. 7

In order to deeply study and implement Xi Jinping Thought on Socialism with Chinese Characteristics for a New Era, especially Xi Jinping's Thought on Ecological Civilization and the spirit of the 19th National Congress of the Communist Party of China, to give full play to the adjudicative functions of people's courts, and to provide more effective judicial services and safeguards for ecological environmental protection in the new era, the following opinions are hereby formulated.

I. Adhere to Guiding Environmental Resources Adjudication Work with Xi Jinping's Thought on Ecological Civilization

1. Effectively raise the political stance and implement Xi Jinping's Thought on Ecological Civilization throughout the entire process of environmental resources adjudication work. Xi Jinping's Thought on Ecological Civilization is an important component of Xi Jinping Thought on Socialism with Chinese Characteristics for a New Era, pointing out the direction for promoting ecological civilization construction in the new era. Strengthening ecological environmental protection is an inevitable requirement for building a great modern socialist country that is prosperous, strong, democratic, culturally advanced, harmonious, and beautiful. People's courts at all levels must deeply study and implement Xi Jinping's Thought on Ecological Civilization, accurately grasp the goals and tasks of serving and safeguarding ecological environmental protection in the new era, effectively raise the political stance, and enhance the sense of responsibility and mission. They must reflect and implement Xi Jinping's Thought on Ecological Civilization throughout the entire process of environmental resources adjudication work, focus on the overall situation, improve ideas, plan development, and comprehensively strengthen judicial services and safeguards for ecological environmental protection in the new era.

2. Guided by Xi Jinping's Thought on Ecological Civilization, establish a new era judicial concept for environmental resources. Adhere to a people-centered approach, continuously meet the people's growing needs for a beautiful ecological environment and fair environmental resources judicial safeguards, and effectively protect the people's right to survive and develop in a healthy, comfortable, and beautiful ecological environment. Adhere to the harmonious coexistence of humans and nature, implement the principle of prioritizing conservation, protection, and natural restoration, use effective legal means to regulate production and living within the carrying capacity of resources and the environment, and promote comprehensive economic development, comprehensive social progress, and comprehensive ecological optimization. Adhere to the concept that lucid waters and lush mountains are invaluable assets, coordinate the relationship between sustainable economic and social development and ecological environmental protection, find the balance point between environmental protection, economic development, and the people's environmental rights and interests, and promote high-quality economic development and high-level ecological environmental protection. Adhere to the systematic protection of mountains, rivers, forests, farmlands, lakes, and grasslands, comprehensively consider the protection needs of various natural ecological elements, explore and innovate adjudication and enforcement methods, and promote holistic ecological environmental protection, systematic restoration, regional coordination, and comprehensive management.

3. Protect the ecological environment with the strictest systems and the most rigorous rule of law. Protecting the ecological environment with the strictest systems and the most rigorous rule of law is an important aspect of Xi Jinping's Thought on Ecological Civilization. People's courts at all levels must deeply study and implement the requirements of Xi Jinping's Thought on Ecological Civilization for strengthening the construction of ecological environmental protection systems and rule of law safeguards, closely focus on the work goal of "striving to make the people feel fairness and justice in every judicial case," effectively implement the basic national policy of conserving resources and protecting the environment, innovate systems and mechanisms, improve adjudication rules, and implement the strictest systems for source protection, damage compensation, and accountability through specialized environmental resources adjudication, continuously improving the level of judicial services and safeguards for ecological environmental protection in the new era.

II. Serve and Safeguard Pollution Prevention and Ecological Security Protection

4. Assist in fighting the battle against pollution. Adjudicate air pollution dispute cases in accordance with the law, severely punish illegal acts of exceeding pollutant discharge standards causing serious air pollution, strengthen the adjudication of air pollution dispute cases in key areas such as Beijing-Tianjin-Hebei and its surrounding areas, the Yangtze River Delta, and the Fenwei Plain, and provide a strong judicial backing for winning the battle for blue skies. Adjudicate water pollution dispute cases in accordance with the law, strengthen the adjudication of water pollution dispute cases in key water bodies such as the Yangtze River, Yellow River, Poyang Lake, Dongting Lake, and Taihu Lake, severely punish illegal acts of polluting drinking water sources, promote the treatment of urban black and odorous water bodies, and protect water environment and water ecological security. Adjudicate soil pollution dispute cases in accordance with the law, accurately determine the responsible parties for soil pollution, explore diverse methods of bearing responsibility, appropriately determine plans for treatment, remediation, and reuse of polluted land, and safeguard food safety and living environment safety. Severely crack down on illegal acts of transferring, dumping, utilizing, and disposing of solid waste and garbage, properly handle mass disputes arising from garbage incineration and landfill, and protect the beautiful living environment. Adjudicate environmental pollution cases caused by noise, vibration, etc., in accordance with the law, reasonably determine the constituent elements of tort liability, and protect the people's right to a quiet life.

5. Protect marine natural resources and the ecological environment in accordance with the law. Punish criminal acts of illegally discharging pollutants into the sea and destroying marine ecological environments such as mangroves and coral reefs in accordance with the law, adjudicate cases involving coastal engineering construction projects, marine engineering construction projects, ships, and related operational activities polluting the environment in accordance with the law, and protect marine ecological environment security. Properly adjudicate various cases involving the introduction of marine animal and plant species, development of island resources, construction of mariculture farms, and marine ecological environment damage compensation cases filed by administrative departments against acts damaging marine ecology, marine aquatic resources, and marine protected areas, and protect the marine ecological environment and natural resources.

6. Comprehensively serve the construction of beautiful villages. Implement the rural revitalization strategy, strengthen the adjudication of cases involving the improvement of rural living environments. Severely punish illegal and criminal acts such as polluting the rural environment, illegal sand mining in rivers, illegal logging of trees, illegal mining and destructive mining, illegal fishing of aquatic products, etc., in accordance with the law, and explore the inclusion of the loss of ecological value of environmental resources as a circumstance for conviction and sentencing. Adjudicate cases involving the prevention and control of agricultural non-point source pollution in accordance with the law, promote the centralized disposal and harmless treatment of multiple pollution sources such as household waste, domestic sewage, livestock and poultry breeding, and agricultural planting, focus on source prevention, and improve rural production, living, and ecological environments. Properly handle dispute cases involving ownership, contracts, torts, etc., arising from returning farmland to forests, grasslands, and wetlands, returning grazing land to grassland, grazing bans and rotational grazing, grass-livestock balance, and fishing restrictions and bans in rivers, lakes, and seas, and promote the construction of diversified ecological compensation mechanisms. Adjudicate contract and tort dispute cases arising from the development of rural eco-tourism in accordance with the law, promote the supply of high-quality agricultural ecological products and services, and assist in the construction of ecologically livable beautiful villages.

7. Continuously improve the level of biodiversity protection. Punish illegal and criminal acts such as illegally hunting and killing precious and endangered wild animals, illegal hunting, and illegal trading of wild animal and plant products in accordance with the law, and maintain species diversity. Severely crack down on illegal and criminal acts of smuggling animals and plants and their products whose import is prohibited by the state, and prevent the invasion of alien species. Properly adjudicate cases of biodiversity and key habitat destruction caused by environmental pollution and excessive development and utilization, and maintain ecosystem diversity. Properly adjudicate cases related to biodiversity protection and biological genetic resources, promote in-situ conservation of endangered wild plant resources, and effectively protect China's biological genetic resource bank. Actively study legal issues related to the protection of property rights in biological resources, paid use, comprehensive utilization, and biotechnology, and promote the improvement of the legal system for biodiversity protection.

8. Strictly safeguard the strategic layout of ecological security. In coordination with the national ecological security strategic layout of "two screens and three belts," strictly observe the red line for ecological protection, the bottom line for environmental quality, and the upper limit for resource utilization. Adjudicate in accordance with the law various cases involving key ecological function areas such as water conservation, soil and water conservation, windbreak and sand fixation, and biodiversity maintenance, as well as ecologically sensitive and fragile areas such as soil erosion sensitive areas, desertification sensitive areas, rocky desertification sensitive areas, and freeze-thaw erosion sensitive areas. Adhere to strict prevention at the source, strict control in the process, and severe punishment for consequences, focus on ecological protection and restoration, and build ecological security barriers.

III. Serve and Safeguard High-Quality Economic Development

9. Promote the construction of a green industrial structure. Properly adjudicate cases involving enterprise restructuring, integration, and bankruptcy caused by economic structure and energy policy adjustments and overcapacity, and support and safeguard the development of energy-saving and environmental protection industries, clean production industries, and clean energy industries in accordance with the law. Properly adjudicate intellectual property disputes in areas such as energy conservation, water conservation, material conservation, and comprehensive resource utilization, including patents, technology contracts, unfair competition, and antitrust, promote market entity innovation and development, and facilitate the transformation and upgrading of traditional enterprises to green industries. Strengthen research on legal risks and regulations related to financial instruments such as green credit, green bonds, and green insurance, and prepare knowledge reserves for the adjudication of new types of cases in the green development field. Through the adjudication of specific cases, promote market entity innovation and development, ensure the implementation of major ecological restoration projects, enhance the production capacity of high-quality ecological products, and ensure the simultaneous improvement of economic, social, and ecological benefits.

10. Promote the formation of green production methods. Properly adjudicate cases involving the development and utilization of natural resources such as land, minerals, and forests, promote the reduction of material consumption in production fields and clean production, and form green production methods that emphasize comprehensive conservation and recycling. Adjudicate cases related to energy-saving services such as energy performance contracting and water conservation contracting in accordance with the law, promote water-saving transformation in agriculture, industry, and urban areas, as well as energy conservation in key areas such as technology and process transformation in mining enterprises, and improve energy and resource utilization efficiency. Conduct in-depth research on the legal attributes, initial allocation, and trading rules of energy use rights, water use rights, emission rights, and carbon emission rights trading, and promote the improvement of the environmental resources trading market system.

11. Promote the formation of green lifestyles. Properly adjudicate cases related to environmental resources in areas such as the sharing economy, green buildings, new energy, and new business forms, and promote greening in production, circulation, and recycling. Increase the publicity of environmental justice, leverage the guiding role of typical cases, cultivate the public's awareness of ecological environmental protection, and promote the formation of a simple, moderate, green, and low-carbon lifestyle throughout society.

12. Encourage enterprises to actively assume social responsibility for ecological environmental protection. Properly handle disputes such as bankruptcy, integration, and employee resettlement arising from the closure, suspension, merger, or transformation of enterprises included in the negative list for industrial access in key ecological function areas. Encourage enterprises to carry out technological innovation and transformation, urge listed companies, bond-issuing enterprises, and key pollution-discharging enterprises to publicly disclose environmental information in accordance with the law, incorporate environmental protection and environmental management requirements into business decision-making mechanisms, and consciously fulfill their primary responsibility for ecological environmental protection. Promote the construction of a green and fair business environment, stimulate the enthusiasm of entrepreneurs for honest operation, resource conservation, and environmental protection, and guide enterprises to actively assume social responsibility for ecological environmental protection and extended producer responsibility.

IV. Serve and Safeguard the Reform of the Ecological Civilization System

13. Adjudicate cases involving property rights disputes over natural resource assets in accordance with the law. Implement the requirements of the reform of the ecological environment supervision system, follow the principles of public ownership of resources, numerus clausus of property rights, and unified registration of rights, properly adjudicate cases involving the registration of rights to natural ecological spaces such as water bodies, forests, mountains, grasslands, wastelands, and mudflats, and ensure that state-owned assets supervision agencies strengthen the protection of state-owned natural resource property rights in accordance with the law. Properly adjudicate administrative cases such as mining rights approval and certification, and real estate expropriation, promote the implementation of main functional area planning, reasonably control the space and intensity of land development, and promote the intensive utilization and orderly development of resources. Adjudicate disputes over usufructuary rights in natural resources such as sea area use rights, mining rights, water abstraction rights, aquaculture rights, fishing rights, and forestry rights in accordance with the law, properly handle the relationship between judicial adjudication and administrative supervision, and maintain the order of resource development and utilization. Properly adjudicate cases involving equity transfers, contracts, cooperation, leases, and mortgages related to the development and utilization of natural resources, and promote the orderly utilization and transfer of natural resources.

14. Strengthen the adjudication of environmental public interest litigation. Implement the requirements of the Civil Procedure Law, Administrative Procedure Law, and Environmental Protection Law, give full play to the function of the environmental public interest litigation system in safeguarding national interests, public interests, and the public's environmental rights, urge administrative law enforcement, and promote the improvement of the environmental governance system. Adjudicate environmental public interest litigation cases filed by social organizations in accordance with the law, smooth the channels for litigation, protect the public interest litigation rights of social organizations, improve trial procedures and supporting mechanisms, and guide the public to participate in ecological environmental protection in an orderly manner. Comprehensively strengthen the adjudication of procuratorial public interest litigation, continuously improve trial procedures and adjudication rules on the basis of following the basic systems of civil and administrative litigation, promote administrative law enforcement and strict law enforcement, and enhance the level of judicial protection of national interests and public interests. Promote the establishment of systems for the management, use, and audit supervision of public interest litigation funds, and ensure that funds are used for the restoration and treatment of damaged ecological environments.

15. Promote the reform of the ecological environment damage compensation system. Implement the requirements of the "Ecological Environment Damage Compensation System Reform Plan" issued by the General Office of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China and the General Office of the State Council, and comprehensively strengthen the adjudication of ecological environment damage compensation cases. Improve the judicial confirmation procedures for compensation agreements, explore the review and announcement system for compensation agreements, and protect the public's right to know. Formulate rules for the衔接 between ecological environment damage compensation litigation and environmental public interest litigation, and promote the improvement of judicial authentication and assessment mechanisms for ecological environment damage. Explore installment payments based on factors such as the subjective fault of the compensation obligor and business conditions, explore diverse methods of bearing responsibility, and study systems such as pre-litigation evidence preservation, advance enforcement, enforcement supervision, and evaluation of the effect of ecological environment restoration that meet the needs of ecological environment damage compensation, ensuring timely and effective restoration of the ecological environment.

16. Highlight the ecological environment governance of key regions. Strengthen the judicial protection of the ecological environment of the Yangtze River Economic Belt, adhere to the principle of great protection and no large-scale development, prioritize the restoration of the Yangtze River ecological environment, fully utilize judicial means to restore damaged ecological environments, promote the continuous improvement of the ecological environment quality of the Yangtze River Basin, and assist in the high-quality development of the Yangtze River Economic Belt. Strengthen judicial protection for the planning and construction of Xiongan New Area and the coordinated development of the Beijing-Tianjin-Hebei region, properly adjudicate environmental resource dispute cases arising from the construction of Xiongan New Area. Strengthen judicial protection for the construction of national ecological civilization pilot zones, accurately serve green economic development, and explore and accumulate useful experiences that can be replicated and promoted. Strengthen judicial protection for national park pilot projects, properly handle disputes arising from the unified environmental access and exit process, promote the construction of a natural protected area system centered on national parks, and strengthen the authenticity and integrity protection of large-scale natural ecosystems. Strengthen judicial protection for the implementation of main functional area planning for land space, based on the different functional positioning of optimized development, key development, restricted development, and prohibited development, determine corresponding case handling ideas, and promote the rational distribution of population and economy compatible with environmental carrying capacity.

V. Improve and Perfect the Systems and Mechanisms for Environmental Resources Adjudication

17. Improve specialized adjudication mechanisms for environmental resources. Adhere to the path of professional development. Higher and intermediate people's courts that meet the conditions may, within the prescribed total number of internal institutions, establish environmental resources adjudication institutions through separate establishment; those that do not yet meet the conditions may set up specialized collegial panels or dedicated adjudication teams within relevant adjudication tribunals to be responsible for environmental resources adjudication work by adding a signboard. Continue to deepen the reform of the court organization system, and explore the establishment of specialized environmental resources courts. Continuously promote the reform of the jurisdiction system for environmental resources, explore the inclusion of major environmental resources cases involving cross-provincial administrative regions within the scope of centralized jurisdiction across administrative regions, and promote cross-regional judicial cooperation and coordinated governance across river basins.

18. Promote the adjudication of environmental resources criminal, civil, and administrative cases by specialized adjudication institutions or professional adjudication teams. Give full play to the combined force of environmental resources criminal, civil, and administrative adjudication, explore the "two-in-one" or "three-in-one" work model where criminal cases related to environmental pollution and ecological damage, environmental resources civil cases, some administrative cases where ecological environment and natural resources administrative departments are defendants, environmental public interest litigation cases, and ecological environment damage compensation cases are adjudicated by specialized environmental resources adjudication institutions or professional adjudication teams, properly coordinate the criminal, civil, and administrative legal liabilities that the parties should bear, and promote the integrated protection and restoration of the ecological environment.

19. Improve the diversified co-governance system for environmental resources disputes. Protect the people's right to know and participate in ecological environmental protection cases, implement the People's Assessors Law, form a seven-person collegial panel to adjudicate major environmental resources cases and public interest litigation cases in accordance with the law, and respect the voting rights of people's assessors on factual findings. Promote the improvement of diversified dispute resolution mechanisms for environmental resources disputes, and give play to the role of non-litigation dispute resolution mechanisms such as administrative mediation, people's mediation, industry mediation, and arbitration. Strengthen evidence extraction, information sharing, and work coordination with public security organs, procuratorial organs, and environmental resources protection administrative departments, promote the construction of a modern environmental governance system led by Party committees, responsible by governments, coordinated by society, participated by the public, and guaranteed by the rule of law, and jointly fight the battle against pollution and the protracted war of ecological civilization construction.

20. Strengthen international judicial exchanges and cooperation in environmental resources adjudication. Establish the concept of a community with a shared future for mankind, promote and guide international judicial exchanges and cooperation in areas such as climate change response, energy conservation and emission reduction, and biodiversity protection. Expand international exchange, training, and mutual visit channels for environmental resources judges, regularly hold international forums on environmental justice, strengthen comparative research on environmental resources laws and sharing of judicial case information, showcase China's achievements in ecological environmental protection and environmental justice development, and widely disseminate China's judicial concepts on environmental resources. Actively participate in global environmental governance, promote the formation of fair, reasonable, and win-win judicial solutions for world environmental protection and sustainable development, and make positive contributions to global ecological civilization construction.

21. Build a professional environmental resources adjudication team. Deeply study and implement Xi Jinping Thought on Socialism with Chinese Characteristics for a New Era, especially Xi Jinping's Thought on Ecological Civilization, firmly establish the "Four Consciousnesses," strengthen the "Four Confidences," and focus on strengthening the ideological and political construction of the environmental resources adjudication team. Adhere to the principle of no forbidden zones for anti-corruption, and in light of the characteristics of environmental resources cases involving significant interests, multiple parties, and sharp conflicts, supervise and educate officers to remain highly vigilant, maintain a constant alarm, and strictly adhere to the bottom line of integrity. Adapt to the requirements of the new era, strengthen professional training and business exchanges in environmental resources adjudication, and strive to build a professional environmental resources adjudication team with strong political awareness, high skills, solid work style, and a sense of responsibility.

May 30, 2018
